items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: That's right, he was the violin player. ... By the time we got to St. Louis Hayes Pillars was in the band. ... Haymen wasn't in the band [initially, but implied later presence or confusion with Hillyard, yet 'we got him in Ohio' suggests membership]

ctx.x: I THINK IT WAS CHESTER CLARK WHO PLAYED WITH YOU AND THE LEAD HAVE BEEN JEETER AND MAYBE HILLYARD. HOLLOWAY WASN'T IN THE BAND STILL AND HAYMEN WASN'T IN THE BAND. SO IT HAS TO BE HILLYARD.
I think Hillyard was on that boat.
